title: Feature Complete Mathematical WFC Crate
description: Build a new headless Rust crate `mathematical_wfc` (bundle `mathematical/wfc/`) implementing Wave Function Collapse as a finite-domain constraint solver with three public solvers sharing one kernel: GraphSolver (reference), Grid2dSolver, Grid3dSolver. Full spec including experimental tier: bitset domains with cached weighted-entropy, AC-3/AC-4/watched-support propagation engines, MRV/entropy/degree observation heuristics, weighted/uniform/temperature/Gumbel sampling, chronological backtracking + conflict-directed backjumping + exhaustive unsat proofs + nogood learning with 2-watched-literals + beam search, cardinality/connectivity/reachability/path/cycle/ordering/symmetry/tuple-table/flow constraints, D4 and cube-rotation symmetry groups, 2D/3D overlapping pattern extraction from samples, chunk streaming, hierarchical macro/micro generation, parallel multi-start, serde model/checkpoint schemas, strict-integer deterministic mode with golden replay diagnostics. Reuses mathematical_random (Rng, AliasTable) and mathematical_graph (GraphView, Csr, MappedHeap, Interner). Registered in workspace Cargo.toml and .vscode/launch.json. Exhaustive inline tests (fundamental/quick/long/exhaustive tiers) including a brute-force oracle, graph-vs-grid differential equivalence, and AC-3-vs-AC-4 fixed-point equivalence.
summary:
Implemented mathematical_wfc, a feature-complete Wave Function Collapse crate covering all 34 sections of the approved spec across 13 phases (P0-P12), including the full experimental tier: nogood learning (two-watched-literal clause propagation), beam search, local repair, chunk streaming primitives, hierarchical macro/micro composition, parallel multi-start, resource-flow constraints, sparse-volume/octree-adjacent graph adapters, graph motif canonicalization (1-WL color refinement), and an evolutionary seed-search outer loop — on top of the stable-tier kernel (bitset domains, AC-3/AC-4 propagation, backtracking search with restarts/budgets/backjumping, GraphSolver/Grid2dSolver/Grid3dSolver, symmetry-aware pattern extraction, global/soft constraints, versioned serialization, decision-trace diagnostics with golden replay).

270 tests passing, cargo clippy clean (only a pre-existing, unrelated warning in mathematical_entropy). Every phase beyond P6 has an explicit scope note (in this ticket folder) documenting any sub-scope deferred beyond the original plan and why, so nothing is a silent gap.

Two real soundness bugs were found and fixed during nogood-learning development (missing AC-3 re-propagation after a forced exclusion; a stale watcher-map entry after moving a watch) — both caught via integration/differential tests, not the isolated unit tests. Also survived, twice, a concurrent repo-wide "single-file consolidation" process that flattened this crate's src/*.rs files into lib.rs mid-session and deleted the originals; recovered both times via a Rust-aware brace-matching split script cross-checked against git history, with zero data loss (documented in memory for future sessions).
